newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index falls at fixing despite KB rise.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index falls at fixing despite KB rise.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index lost ground on Tuesday morning despite more surprise gains to Komercni Banka, the index's biggest banking issue.
After posting sharply lower first half profits last Thursday Komercni added to solid gains on Monday with a near three percent rise at the fixing. Dealers were bewildered.
"I don't know why today it's rising so far. For me it's very strange because just a few days ago everybody was trashing Komercni," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
SPT Telecom was the only other major issue gainer, edging up three crowns to 3,87.
CEZ continued to post sharp fluctuations. The issue fell back 21 crowns to 902.
